content.title: Chapter 3
content.subtitle: Scaling Up Private Sector Investment in Sustainable Energy
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the third chapter of the Just Energy Transition Module. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.

nextBlock.title: Chapter 4: Innovative Financial Instruments and Tools for Renewable Energy
nextBlock.cta: This chapter explores innovative financial tools—blended finance, bonds, swaps, carbon finance—that reduce risks and mobilize capital for renewables.
